# Episode summary format

Every finalised episode folder holds `episode.json`: what the episode
is and what happened while it was recorded, readable without opening
the recording. Format `kapto.episode`, version 1. It is listed in
the [manifest](manifest.md) like every other file.

Message counts follow one rule per stream: every message received is
either `written` or `dropped_by_us`, and `lost_upstream` counts
messages that never reached Kapto. What `lost_upstream` means depends
on `loss_detection`: exact with `sequence`, an estimate with
`rate_gap`, and always 0 with `undetectable`.

New versions only add fields. A reader that finds a version newer
than it knows treats the file as unreadable rather than guess.

## JSON Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Episode",
  "description": "What an episode is and what happened while it was recorded.",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "buffers": {
      "description": "How close the buffers between receiving and writing came to full.",
      "$ref": "#/$defs/BufferSummary"
    },
    "clock": {
      "description": "How the host's clock behaved during the episode.",
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ClockSummary"
    },
    "commanded_start_utc_ns": {
      "description": "When Start was asked, or `kapto record` began, on the same clock.",
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "format": "int64"
    },
    "commanded_stop_utc_ns": {
      "description": "When Stop was asked, or the episode's duration was up, on the same\nclock. Absent if it ended otherwise: aborted, the disk full, the\nprocess stopped.",
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "format": "int64"
    },
    "durability": {
      "description": "How long received messages waited before they were on disk, which\nbounds what a power cut could have lost.",
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DurabilitySummary"
    },
    "ended_utc_ns": {
      "description": "When recording ended, after any post-roll, on the same clock.",
      "type": "integer",
      "format": "int64"
    },
    "format": {
      "description": "Always `\"kapto.episode\"`.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "id": {
      "description": "The episode's ID, the same as its folder name.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "kapto_version": {
      "description": "The version of Kapto that recorded it.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "package": {
      "description": "The robot package the streams were declared in, as it was when\nrecording started. Absent when they weren't declared in one: the\nepisode is `unchecked`, recorded exactly as received with no robot\nto check it against.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/PackageIdentity"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "preflight": {
      "description": "Pre-flight's latest run when the episode started: whether this\nmachine could record what the robot sends, each check with whether\nit passed and, if it failed, whether it was waived to record anyway.\nAbsent if pre-flight never ran, as for `kapto record`.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Preflight"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "profile": {
      "description": "The session profile it was recorded with: with which robot, by\nwhom, where and how. A copy as it was when recording started, so the\nepisode keeps it however the profile changes later. Absent when none\nwas chosen.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionProfile"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "recording": {
      "description": "The recording's file name in the episode folder.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "recovered": {
      "description": "Present only for an episode recovered after recording stopped\nwithout finishing it, by a crash, a kill or a power cut: its\nrecording was salvaged to its last intact record. Its counts are\nwhat the recording holds; how many messages were lost, by Kapto or\nbefore it, isn't known.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Recovered"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "started_utc_ns": {
      "description": "When its first message was received, its pre-roll's if it has one,\nor when recording began if that was earlier: the receive clock\nmapped to UTC, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.",
      "type": "integer",
      "format": "int64"
    },
    "streams": {
      "description": "Every stream, in the order they were declared.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/StreamSummary"
      }
    },
    "task": {
      "description": "The task it was recorded for: what the robot was asked to do. A copy\nas it was when recording started. Absent when none was chosen.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionTask"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "version": {
      "description": "The format version; versions only ever add fields.",
      "type": "integer",
      "format": "uint32",
      "minimum": 0
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "format",
    "version",
    "id",
    "kapto_version",
    "started_utc_ns",
    "ended_utc_ns",
    "recording",
    "clock",
    "buffers",
    "durability",
    "streams"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "BufferSummary": {
      "description": "How full the buffers between receiving and writing got.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "batches": {
          "description": "Batches of messages the buffers hold.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "memory_bytes": {
          "description": "Memory the buffers take, in bytes, set when recording starts.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "peak_batches": {
          "description": "The most batches ever waiting for the writer at once. Messages are\ndropped only when every batch is waiting.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "batches",
        "peak_batches",
        "memory_bytes"
      ]
    },
    "ClockStepRecord": {
      "description": "One step of the wall clock.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "at_mono_ns": {
          "description": "The receive clock, in nanoseconds, of the first sample after the step.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "change_ns": {
          "description": "How far the wall clock moved, in nanoseconds; negative if back.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "int64"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "at_mono_ns",
        "change_ns"
      ]
    },
    "ClockSummary": {
      "description": "How the host's clock behaved during an episode. The full clock map is in\nthe recording's `kapto.clock_map` metadata record.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "max_uncertainty_ns": {
          "description": "The largest gap between the two readings of one sample, in\nnanoseconds: how precisely receive times map to UTC.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "samples": {
          "description": "How many times both clocks were read together.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "steps": {
          "description": "Every time the wall clock was stepped (e.g. by time sync) during the\nepisode. Receive times aren't affected; times mapped to UTC are\noffset by the steps after the first sample.",
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClockStepRecord"
          }
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "samples",
        "max_uncertainty_ns",
        "steps"
      ]
    },
    "DurabilitySummary": {
      "description": "How long received messages waited before they were on disk.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "max_sync_ns": {
          "description": "The longest a single sync took, in nanoseconds.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "max_unsynced_ns": {
          "description": "The longest any message waited, in nanoseconds.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "p50_unsynced_ns": {
          "description": "Half of the messages were on disk within this many nanoseconds.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "p99_unsynced_ns": {
          "description": "99 % of the messages were on disk within this many nanoseconds.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "sync_interval_ns": {
          "description": "How often the recording was put on disk, in nanoseconds.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "syncs": {
          "description": "How many times it was.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "sync_interval_ns",
        "syncs",
        "max_sync_ns",
        "p50_unsynced_ns",
        "p99_unsynced_ns",
        "max_unsynced_ns"
      ]
    },
    "LossDetectionKind": {
      "description": "How a stream's upstream loss was detected.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "description": "From gaps in the sequence numbers in its messages: exact.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "sequence"
        },
        {
          "description": "From silences longer than its declared rate allows: an estimate.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "rate_gap"
        },
        {
          "description": "Not at all: `lost_upstream` is always 0 and says nothing.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "undetectable"
        },
        {
          "description": "From gaps in its publishers' own counts of their messages, which a\nROS 2 middleware gives with each (Fast DDS and Zenoh do): exact for\nevery message after the first received.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "publisher_count"
        }
      ]
    },
    "OperationMode": {
      "description": "How the robot was driven while an episode was recorded.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "description": "By a person.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "teleoperated"
        },
        {
          "description": "By a policy: a rollout, kept and findable whether it went well or\nnot.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "autonomous"
        },
        {
          "description": "By a policy that a person took over at times.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "mixed"
        },
        {
          "description": "By a fixed program.",
          "type": "string",
          "const": "scripted"
        }
      ]

    "PackageIdentity": {
      "description": "Which robot package, and exactly which files of it, an episode was\nrecorded with.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "hash": {
          "description": "Its content hash when recording started, as lowercase hex: changes\nwhenever any of its files does, so two episodes with the same hash\nwere recorded with exactly the same package.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "id": {
          "description": "Its ID, as its `package.toml` says.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "version": {
          "description": "Its version, as its `package.toml` says.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id",
        "version",
        "hash"
      ]
    },
    "Preflight": {
      "description": "A pre-flight run: whether this machine could record what the robot\nsends, checked before recording.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "checks": {
          "description": "Every check: the disk's room, its speed, then each stream in\ndeclaration order.",
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/PreflightCheck"
          }
        },
        "ran_at": {
          "description": "When it finished, in UTC, ISO 8601.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "window_ms": {
          "description": "How long the streams were watched, in milliseconds.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "ran_at",
        "window_ms",
        "checks"
      ]
    },
    "PreflightCheck": {
      "description": "One pre-flight check.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "description": "The cause code the check fails with, which names it too, e.g.\n`preflight.stream_silent`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "measured": {
          "description": "What was measured, in words.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "needed": {
          "description": "What recording needs, in words.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "passed": {
          "description": "Whether what was measured is enough.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "stream": {
          "description": "The stream it is about, for a stream's check.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "waived": {
          "description": "Whether the operator chose to record despite its failure.",
          "type": "boolean",
          "default": false
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "code",
        "passed",
        "measured",
        "needed"
      ]
    },
    "Recovered": {
      "description": "How an episode was recovered.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "at_utc_ns": {
          "description": "When it was recovered, in UTC nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "int64"
        },
        "bytes_cut": {
          "description": "Bytes cut off the end of its recording: records written only in\npart, or not put on disk before recording stopped.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0

        "bytes_cut",
        "reason"

    "SessionProfile": {
      "description": "The session profile an episode was recorded with.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "environment": {
          "description": "Where it was recorded.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]

        "hash": {
          "description": "What it says, as a SHA-256 in lowercase hex ([`content_hash`]): the\nsame for every episode recorded with exactly this profile, whatever\nits file is called.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "id": {
          "description": "Its ID: the profile file's name without `.toml`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "mode": {
          "description": "How the robot was driven.",

        "notes": {
          "description": "Anything else worth knowing.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"

        "operator": {
          "description": "Who operated the robot.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]

        "tags": {
          "description": "Words to find the episode by.",
          "type": "array",
          "items": {

          }
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ]
    },
    "SessionTask": {
      "description": "The task an episode was recorded for.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "description": {
          "description": "A sentence or two about it.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "hash": {
          "description": "What it says, as a SHA-256 in lowercase hex ([`content_hash`]): the\nsame for every episode recorded for exactly this task, whatever its\nfile is called.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "id": {
          "description": "Its ID: the task file's name without `.toml`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "name": {
          "description": "What people call it.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "objects": {
          "description": "The objects it involves.",
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }

          "description": "The instruction given to the operator or the policy.",

            "string",
            "null"
          ]

        "subtasks": {
          "description": "Its steps in order.",
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ]
    },
    "StreamSummary": {
      "description": "One stream's message counts. Every message received is either written or\ndropped by Kapto; `lost_upstream` never reached Kapto at all.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "carried": {
          "description": "For a stream whose messages are kept for late subscribers: how many\nkept from before the episode it starts with, written at its start\nand not counted in `received` or `written`. Absent for other streams.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "decoded": {
          "description": "Received messages whose live fields could be read.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "disconnects": {
          "description": "For a stream that arrives over a connection (TCP): how many times\nthe connection was lost. Whatever the robot sent while it was down\nnever arrived. Absent for streams without a connection.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "dropped_by_us": {
          "description": "Received messages Kapto discarded.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "id": {
          "description": "The stream's name.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "loss_detection": {
          "description": "How loss before Kapto was detected, which says what `lost_upstream`\nmeans.",
          "$ref": "#/$defs/LossDetectionKind"
        },
        "lost_upstream": {
          "description": "Messages the source sent that never reached Kapto.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "post_roll": {
          "description": "For a stream with a post-roll: how many of `written` were received\nafter Stop was asked. Absent for other streams.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "pre_roll": {
          "description": "For a stream with a pre-roll: how many of `written` were received\nbefore Start was asked. Absent for other streams.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "received": {
          "description": "Messages that reached Kapto.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "rejected": {
          "description": "For a UDP stream only some sources may send to\n(`allowed_sources`): datagrams from any other, discarded. They\naren't the robot's, so they are neither received nor lost. Absent\nfor other streams.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "written": {
          "description": "Received messages stored in the recording.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id",
        "loss_detection",
        "received",
        "decoded",
        "written",
        "dropped_by_us",
        "lost_upstream"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
